mapper.select: select * from T_CX_PRECISION_PLAN where COMPLETION_STATUS = '0' and DAYS_TO_DUE <= #{daysToDue} and DAYS_TO_DUE > 0 and WARNING_STATUS = '0' and IS_DELETE = 0 order by DAYS_TO_DUE asc
mapper.update: update T_CX_PRECISION_PLAN set DAYS_TO_DUE = DATEDIFF(PLAN_DATE, CURDATE()) where IS_DELETE = 0 and COMPLETION_STATUS = '0'
